cases.description: UX-03 LH01 unit (KI-77): LauncherLayer::ScanForProjects(dirs) over a temp dir holding a copy of the real Starforge.dll and of AP01ServiceFixture.dll returns exactly {Starforge} (the fixture exports CreatePluginLayer AND the CS_TEST_FIXTURE marker; the marker wins), also in the member's {dir/projects, dir} shape; every *Fixture.dll in the runtime dir exports CosmicTestFixture (GetProcAddress probe over the nine tests/*Fixture.cpp targets, a missing one is a failure); WO07NoExport.dll exports no entry point and the runtime-dir scan lists no fixture and not WO07NoExport.

UX-03 LH01 W (KI-77): the REAL Cosmic Launcher - CosmicApp.exe started with no arguments and CWD = the runtime dir (the scan reads the CWD) - logs its found-list line ('LauncherLayer: scan found N project(s): [...]'); it names Starforge and SF_Telem and no *Fixture (nor WO07NoExport); the per-fixture skip lines are counted. Only the started process is closed (CloseMainWindow, then Kill of that PID).

UX-03 LH02 - AP-03's E06 extended, inside the REAL Starforge editor (Projects/Starforge/src/AP03AuthoringSelfTest.cpp through Run-AP03Authoring.ps1, the whole E01-E08/F01/V05 sequence and its out-of-process oracles unchanged): ListSamples() = templates/samples/* + <SdkDir()>/Projects/* (never Starforge); App samples = [PendulumLab] featured and first; Game samples hold FlowDemo + ForgePong from templates/samples; AnalysisSample (no kind key) last under Other samples; game, blank, FlowDemo, ForgePong and PendulumLab each scaffold/copy to SamplePath (COSMIC_STARFORGE_PROJECTS_DIR), open, BuildScripts and Play; the PendulumLab copy carries the seeded .starforge/thumb.png and the SDK's Projects/PendulumLab stays byte-identical; the welcome popup (m_OpenFirstRun, armed on the fresh profile) offers PendulumLab; the New Project modal opens with App selected; Prefs::LoadProjects <= 3 over 600 homescreen frames.
